d199_vcall_narrow_decl_i32_norm.why: THE PRICE, and it is why D351 stays open. Folding the arm's `$fnsig` token onto the struct twin's (`repSigSlotTokOfKind("struct", variantStructHeapTwinAt(rep))`) buys the 12 cells above and takes these 6 from `runs` to check-clean invalid wasm: the token CHAR is what `sigParamKindAt` reports, so an arm parameter spelled `s…;` stops being a `variant` parameter and the value-call arm coercion never fires on it.
